description: This header file declares functions and structures related to monitoring the health of a daemon process within a filesystem monitoring subsystem. It includes platform-specific initialization, cleanup, and loop functions for a health thread, as well as a stop mechanism.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initialize platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleanup platform-specific data for the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Main body of the platform-specific event loop to monitor the health of the daemon.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Gently request that the health thread shutdown without waiting for it.
